name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=battle, descriptor=view_window_origin_y (viewport top-edge tile row). The trailing _y is a semantic axis suffix, not a Ghidra address residue (0x53AAD does not end in _y). Paired with data_fd2_battle_view_window_origin_x @ 0x53AA9. Name correctly reflects the scalar coordinate role.
purpose: Battle viewport window origin Y: the map tile row of the on-screen viewport's top edge; runtime camera-scroll state for vertical scrolling.
logic_summary: Zero at load (BSS). First set by battle/chapter init and save-load (e.g. fd2_init_battle_state_for_chapter, fd2_load_save_and_init_engine, fd2_chapter_*_end), then incremented/decremented by the cursor-move (fd2_cursor_move_up/down) and pan (fd2_pan_cursor_and_window) functions as the viewport scrolls vertically. fd2_cursor_move_up scrolls the view up (DEC) when near the top edge with room to scroll (origin_y != 0); fd2_cursor_move_down scrolls down (INC) unless at max scroll (origin_y == map_height_tiles - 8). Read by many compositing/animation routines to position the camera.
element_semantics: Single scalar: tile row index of the viewport's top edge. Range 0 .. map_height_tiles - 8 (viewport is 8 tiles tall). DWORD access width confirmed by disassembly (DEC/INC/CMP/MOV dword ptr [0x53AAD]).
notes: Ghidra plate was empty (<null>); created a concise plate reflecting the src conclusion (per rule: update plate only when missing/contradictory/stale). src comment block (cursor.c lines 276-286) is already precise and correct against the disassembly evidence (DWORD access, INC/DEC by cursor-move/pan, BSS zero-init, range 0..map_height_tiles-8), so comment_verdict=keep and cursor.c was NOT edited. is_const=false: many game-side writers exist (cursor-move/pan READ_WRITE, init/save-load/chapter-end WRITE). Memory at 0x53AAD reads all zeros (BSS). Only the shard file is staged for commit.
